Here is the recap for the **Rackwell Back-to-School Free Trial Push** (`Wednesday, July 28 – Saturday, July 31, 2027 CT`).

### Overall Flight Totals
- **Total Spend:** **$446.54** (`446,544,435` micro USD out of the $450.00 total budget — 99.2% utilization)
- **Total Impressions:** **288,207**
- **Total Link Clicks:** **237** (Average CPC: **$1.88** | Link CTR: **0.082%**)
- **Total Engagements:** **2,122** (including 70 likes)

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)
All ad groups were configured with `WEBSITE_CLICKS` (`LINK_CLICKS` optimization, `DEFINED` audience expansion) targeting **United States (`96683cc9126741d1`)** and **iOS (`0`)** only:

| Line Item | Audience Segment | Status | Spend | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg CPC | Link CTR |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`vx0ra`** (`LI-1`) | Workouts & Health/Fitness + Core Keywords (`dumbbell workout`, `home workout`, `strength training`) | Ran full flight | $216.27 | 110,491 | 117 | $1.85 | 0.106% |
| **`oua2b`** (`LI-6`) | Workouts & Health/Fitness + Core Keywords (Scaled top creatives on Day 2) | Ran Days 2–4 | $100.43 | 60,339 | 53 | $1.89 | 0.088% |
| **`i82pz`** (`LI-2`) | Education, Workouts & Athletics + Back-to-School Keywords (`back to school`, `dorm workout`) | Ran full flight | $90.89 | 78,511 | 51 | $1.78 | 0.065% |
| **`is4w1`** (`LI-5`) | Workouts + Broad Home Gym Keywords (`dumbbell`, `lifting`, `garage gym`, `semester`) | Paused Day 2 | $19.44 | 19,356 | 9 | $2.16 | 0.046% |
| **`qth43`** (`LI-3`) | Workouts, Nutrition & Broad Sports Interests (no keyword qualifier) | Paused Day 1 | $13.17 | 16,010 | 4 | $3.29 | 0.025% |
| **`zqa0v`** (`LI-4`) | Workouts Creative Test (testing doorstop hook post) | Paused Day 1 | $6.34 | 3,500 | 3 | $2.11 | 0.086% |
| **Total** | **Campaign `o3t8v`** | **Completed** | **$446.54** | **288,207** | **237** | **$1.88** | **0.082%** |

---

### Performance by Approved Post
Because X had no conversion pixel on `https://rackwellapp.com/trial`, we focused budget on posts that linked directly to `/trial` and pre-qualified clickers on the landing page offer (**25-minute dumbbell plans, 14-day free trial, cancel anytime, US & iPhone only**):

| Post ID | Post Copy Summary | Spend | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg CPC | Link CTR |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`2213877070035552849`** | *"Rackwell plans your week of 25-minute dumbbell workouts and raises the weights as you get stronger. 14-day free trial..."* (`/trial`) | $192.81 | 99,875 | 103 | $1.87 | 0.103% |
| **`2213514682171477349`** | *"Back to school, back to lifting. Rackwell gives you 25-minute dumbbell plans for a dorm room or living room. 14-day free trial..."* (`/trial`) | $132.21 | 103,657 | 70 | $1.89 | 0.068% |
| **`2214058263967969601`** | *"Classes start soon. Build the habit this week: start a 14-day free Rackwell trial before the semester takes over..."* (`/trial`) | $117.10 | 83,381 | 62 | $1.89 | 0.074% |
| **`2214239457902789739`** | *"Be honest: how many of your dumbbells are holding a door open right now?"* (`/trial`) — *Paused Day 1 (higher CPC & didn't pre-qualify the app/trial offer)* | $4.42 | 1,294 | 2 | $2.21 | 0.155% |
| **`2213695876104725484`** | *"We have an app! Take a look when you get a chance. https://rackwellapp.com"* — *Withheld (wrong URL & no offer details)* | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | — | — |

### Key Optimizations Made During the Flight
1. **Strict Eligibility Filtering:** Locked every ad group to **United States** and **iOS** with `audience_expansion=DEFINED` so zero budget was wasted on non-iPhone or non-US users.
2. **Audience Pruning:** On Day 1, broad Sports/Nutrition interest targeting (`qth43`) yielded a 0.025% CTR ($3.29 CPC), and on Day 2 broad home-gym keywords (`is4w1`) yielded a 0.046% CTR ($2.16 CPC). Both were paused early, and budget was reallocated to `vx0ra` and `oua2b` (`Workouts` + `Health & Fitness` paired with `dumbbell workout`, `home workout`, and `strength training`), which delivered 99% of our clicks at $1.78–$1.89 CPC.
3. **Creative Message-Match:** Concentrated 99% of spend (`$442.12` / `235` of `237` link clicks) on the three high-intent posts (`2213877070035552849`, `2213514682171477349`, and `2214058263967969601`) that matched the `/trial` landing page offer.
